sources.title: Hong Kong corporation return notes: assessable profits before brought-forward losses
Hong Kong profits tax: statutory deductions and treatment of losses

findings: BIR51 assessable profits/adjusted loss are before brought-forward losses.
Accounting profits need statutory additions and deductions, including replacing accounting depreciation with eligible statutory allowances.
Approved donations have a limit before loss set-off.
Prior losses must remain separate from current-period assessable profits and the final net amount charged.
implementation_requirements: Reconcile saved receipts and allowable deductions with separately recorded statutory adjustments/exclusions.
Show current assessable profits, actual loss relief and net taxable profits separately; preserve historical snapshots.
Do not infer donation, capital allowance, offshore/FSIE or loss eligibility from arithmetic alone.
validation_pending: Adapter rejection of inconsistent saved deductions
Corporate and sole-proprietor tax cases with and without loss set-off
Persistence, restart, report and browser workflow
